answer: Practically, the chain should stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because raven only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, ferrous is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any thread approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
